This site summarizes a collaboration on how GLI-mediated Hedgehog signaling
affects neuronal progenitor differentiation. GLI is overexpressed and then
perturbed or removed, and gene expression is measured over time. The
collaborator grouped the responsive genes into 10 clusters with maSigPro.

We test whether these clusters are enriched for genes implicated in
neurodevelopmental disorders. Autism (SFARI, TADA) and combined
neurodevelopmental disorders (NDD) come first. Schizophrenia (MAGMA with GWAS)
is planned.

Analysis code and data: `/project/xinhe/xsun/GLI-Hedgehog_Signaling`
(stage 1 scripts in `1.geneset_enrichment/`).
